LESSON: MAKING CHOICES

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.3: Making choices

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Making choices. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What are the effects of the choices you make?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. list choices they make in day-to-day life,
2. discuss results of choices they make in daily life,
3. make right choices guided by the word of God,
4. portray responsibility by making right choices. The learner is guided to: in day-to-day life, make, choices, choices that are acceptable to God.’ What are the effects of the choices you make? ϯ

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. list choices they make in day-to-day life,

4. portray responsibility by making right choices. The learner is guided to: in day-to-day life, make, choices, choices that are acceptable to God.’ What are the effects of the choices you make? ϯ

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Making choices.
2. Explain Making choices to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: in pairs, list choices they make in day-to-day life,
4. Show that you can: list choices they make in day-to-day life,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Making choices. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What are the effects of the choices you make?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In pairs, list choices they make in day-to-day life,
2. List results of choices that they make,
3. Sing a song about good choices,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. list choices they make in day-to-day life,
2. discuss results of choices they make in daily life,
3. make right choices guided by the word of God,
4. portray responsibility by making right choices. The learner is guided to: in day-to-day life, make, choices, choices that are acceptable to God.’ What are the effects of the choices you make? ϯ
